item.title: Euna Solutions Acquires GrantExec
item.description: Euna Solutions®, a provider of purpose-built cloud solutions for the public sector, acquired GrantExec, an AI-native startup intended to simplifying grant discovery and research for nonprofits, universities, and community-focused organizations. The acquisition further expands Euna’s grants portfolio by accelerating advanced AI-powered grant research capabilities within the Euna Grants software suite. Financial details of the acquisition were not announced. GrantExec’s team will join Euna Solutio
